questions.stem: In the pondweed experiment, how is the rate of photosynthesis measured?

options.text: By counting the number of oxygen bubbles produced per minute
By measuring the change in mass of the pondweed
By observing the colour change of the water
By measuring the temperature of the water

questions.explanation: The rate of photosynthesis in pondweed is measured by counting the number of oxygen bubbles released per unit time, as oxygen is a product of photosynthesis.
